title: LLM provider settings
desc: API keys stay on the local server (server-data/settings.json), never in the browser bundle. Live calls power only the read-only general-inquiry node; the recorded demo runs offline.
llmDesc: All cards are always rendered. Configure an API key to query models and set a default.
decisionDesc: Decision models (System One) run alongside the main chat model; they don't use /chat/completions.
fallbackDesc: switch model within the same provider, then switch provider
defaultModel: Default model (drag to reorder fallback chain)
hostedTitle: Not available in the hosted demo
hostedDesc: This screen configures real LLM API keys, which needs the local dev server (npm run dev). The hosted build is a static site with no backend. The four demo screens need no model at all — they run on recorded fixtures.
probeDesc: Answers from a built-in FAQ library with sources cited. Read-only: no case actions, no customer data. Shows a recorded answer when no key is configured or the call fails.
probePlaceholder: e.g. What are your branch hours?
